question: Why did the apparent 2024-2026 eligible count fall from 1,152 to the M3 validation 1,100 races?
raw_rule: class_code>=67 and field_size>=12 before obstacle exclusion
finding: The entire 52-race difference is obstacle racing: 10 JG graded races plus 42 obstacle open races. After excluding obstacle races, the flat eligible universe is exactly 1,100 races = 2024:400, 2025:403, 2026:297.
selection_bias_assessment: No flat race was lost from the 2024-2026 M3 universe because of PCI/RPCI/-3F missingness. The earlier 1,152 count was not a flat-race denominator; it accidentally included obstacle races.
